# Roleplay Rule 0 - Roleplay Comes Above All
If an action is deemed to be done in benefit of general player experience, storytelling or roleplay, admins retain the right to permit it.
[bold]This is not a green-light to break rules[/bold]; it’s a green-light to play a believable character and do your best to improve the round’s story as long as it doesn’t detract from others’ gameplay.
[bold]Do not push this rule.[/bold] If you have to argue in admin help about this rule, it’s because you’re not following it.
## Precedents - This rule extends to crew/antag interactions and relations. If you are unsure about the limits of this rule please ask in admin help (F1) [bold]BEFORE[/bold] you act on your plan.
